name: Portfolio Adapter
description: Provide portfolio data to dashboard panels from a compatible upstream plugin or shared service.

displayName.title: Name in admin
displayName.description: Name this copy for its purpose, such as Lobby weather or Workshop energy. Its connection ID stays the same.

provider.title: Data source
provider.description: Choose the compatible data service or connected plugin that supplies this copy.

route.title: Data route
route.description: Route exposed by the shared service, such as /api/weather. Only supported routes can be used.
